decision_detail: governance/lessons/ledger.jsonl (kushin77/agent-orchestrator) is the single writer; kushin77/deepseek's view is derived and read-only; the kushin77/CMR docs/LESSONS.md consolidated index is the second (org-level) derived view, declared but unconfirmed; sync is one-way writer -> derived; peer lessons enter only through a reviewed direction/harvest item carrying provenance, so two symmetric stores can never exist.

cmr_hub.note: Second lessons ledger: the CMR hub's consolidated index. No mechanical coupling with governance/lessons/ledger.jsonl exists today (no shared record ids, no cross-reference), so this is a DECLARED INTENT, not a confirmed mapping. The frozen baseline is governance/lessons-sync/cmr-ledger.json; every CMR record must carry a disposition (hub-only, or mirrors naming a local counterpart) and a record with none is reported by id.

hint_transport.local_equivalent: the brain directive recorded in .fleet/sent plus the governance/dispatch claim chain
hint_transport.provenance: every hint carries the lesson id, an issue reference, and a commit sha
